blocks.text: Elements ka metallic character (dhaat jaisa hona) un ka electrons khone ki tendency (rujhan) hai. Periodic table ke baen taraf ke elements noble gas jaisi configuration hasil karne ke liye apne bahar wale electrons khone ki zyada tendency rakhte hain. Is ke ulat daen taraf ke elements electrons lene ki tendency rakhte hain. Is liye baen taraf ke elements metals hain jo positive ions banate hain, aur daen taraf, khaas kar daen kone ke elements non-metals hain jo negative ions banate hain. Nateeja: kisi element ka metallic character zyada tar us ke valence shell ki electronic configuration par depend karta hai.

blocks.text: Period mein baen se daen nuclear charge barhta hai aur atom ka size kam hota hai, is liye valence electrons par attraction (kashish) mazboot hoti hai. Nateeja: elements ka metallic character kam hota hai. Doosre lafzon mein, barhta nuclear charge electron cloud ko nucleus ke qareeb kheenchta hai, atom ke liye electron khona mushkil ho jata hai aur metallic character kam ho jata hai. Yani period mein baen se daen metallic character kam hota hai.

Is ke ulat group mein neeche jate hue metallic character barhta hai. Wajah: atom ka size aur shielding effect barhte hain, jo valence electrons par nucleus ki attraction kam kar dete hain. Metallic character barhne (electron asani se khone) se element zyada reactive ho jata hai. Isi liye cesium, sodium ya lithium se kahin zyada reactive aur electropositive hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Group 14 mein metallic character kaise badalta hai? Samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Group 14 mein oopar carbon (non-metal) hai, phir silicon aur germanium (metalloids), aur neeche tin aur lead (metals). Yani group mein neeche metallic character barhta hai, kyun ke atom bara hota hai aur valence electrons par shielding barhti hai, is liye electrons khona asaan hota jata hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Groups 14, 15 aur 16 mein semimetals (metalloids) pehchanein. Yeh semimetals kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Group 14: Si, Ge; group 15: As, Sb; group 16: Te (kitab Se aur Po ko bhi metalloids mein ginti hai). Yeh stair-step line ke saath hain, jo metals aur non-metals ko alag karti hai, aur in mein dono ki kuch properties hain (maslan chamak aur thori conductivity, magar brittle (bhurbhure) aur oxides kuch acidic), is liye semimetals hain.

items: Metallic character = electrons khone ki tendency; yeh valence shell configuration par depend karta hai.
Period mein baen se daen kam, group mein neeche zyada; isi liye cesium sodium aur lithium se zyada reactive hai.
